title: Optimizing Multi-Departmental Cloud Spend
business: Large enterprises with multiple business units sharing a single Azure subscription.
problem: Lack of visibility into which specific departments are driving cost spikes, leading to budget overruns and inefficient resource allocation.
solution: Utilizing Azure Cost Management to implement granular tagging, automated budget alerts, and scheduled cost exports for cross-departmental chargeback reporting.
steps: Apply consistent resource tags to all assets to categorize costs by department or project.
Configure Cost Management budgets with email alerts triggered at 50%, 80%, and 100% of the allocated spend.
Create scheduled exports to store cost data in an Azure Storage account for long-term analysis.
Review cost analysis dashboards to identify underutilized resources and apply recommendations.
outcome: Improved financial accountability and proactive identification of cost-saving opportunities through data-driven insights.
limitation: Cost data latency; usage information typically takes up to 24 hours to appear in the portal, meaning real-time spending tracking is not possible.
